provider: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

r_package.copyright_holder: David Freedman and contributors (as declared in R package DESCRIPTION)
r_package.name: cdcanthro

r_package_usage_and_packaging_basis: The GPL-3 cdcanthro R package provides a separate reference implementation of CDC/WHO standardized metrics and related tables for independent numerical validation. CDC original downloads govern the exact packed LMS values, and the Python dataset conversion and packaging code is independently authored.
scientific_values_origin: The values are derived from original CDC 2000 LMS downloads and the CDC 2022 extended BMI LMS/sigma file, with separately implemented CDC calculation methods. The cdcanthro R package provides a GPL-3 computation and some packaged reference data for independent comparison. The public CDC files, not the GPL R package, are the direct source of the packaged pedgrowth coefficients; no claim is made that the newer CDC 2022 extended BMI dataset comes from cdcanthro.

validation.independent_oracle: Official CDC published percentile tables plus cdcanthro R 0.4.0 computed extended-BMI challenges
validation.input_origin: CDC 2000 published LMS datasets, CDC 2022 published extended-BMI LMS/sigma data and published percentiles
validation.limitations: The 2022 extended-BMI data are sourced from CDC, not from the cdcanthro R distribution.
